name: Command Core
desc: Heart of the station: a small reactor, two bunks and a storage hold.

name: Floor
desc: Pressurised deck plating. Modules sit on floor. Each tile leaks a little oxygen.

name: Battery
desc: Stores surplus power and covers deficits before a brownout hits.

name: O2 Generator
desc: Splits water into breathable air. Stops when unpowered.

name: Hydroponics
desc: Grows food under lamps; the plants add a little oxygen too.

name: Crew Quarters
desc: Bunks for four. More beds, more crew.

name: Storage Bay
desc: Tanks and crates. Raises the oxygen and food cap.

name: Docking Port
desc: Lets shuttles bring new crew when there are free beds, air and food.
